name: motion-trace
description: One region of one swept run over time: how far it moves or turns, each move's length and overshoot, its period, and the curve that fits. Cached by the sweep's content and the question asked.

verbs.name: trace
verbs.description: Follow a box in one run of a full-frame sweep. Prints one line per move, or the whole trace with --json.

sweep.description: The sweep.json from page-sweep capture, which keeps every frame.

box.description: The region in page pixels, as x0,y0,x1,y1. Centre it on a part that turns.

bundle.description: A bundle.json whose easings join the curves tried.
